# GitHub Copilot Instructions

This repository implements the Drakom AI Dev Kit, a CLI (`drakom-ai init` and `drakom-ai sync`) plus three kit-managed skills that keep AI agent context in one place across Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and GitHub Copilot.
Before generating code, inspect and follow repository guidelines defined in:
- `AGENTS.md` (Standards Index and task routing)
- `.drakom-ai/rules/coding.md` (Language idioms and prohibited patterns)
- `.drakom-ai/rules/testing.md` (Mock isolation and testing conventions)
